feedback: The illustration accurately depicts Jesus calmly listening to the urgent, weary messenger on a dusty road as described.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus arriving at the village with a somber atmosphere and mourning villagers in the background.
The illustration beautifully and accurately captures Mary weeping prostrate at Jesus' feet, surrounded by sorrowful mourners in a dusty village setting.
The illustration faithfully depicts a sorrowful, weeping Jesus walking with mourning followers near hillside tombs.
The illustration beautifully captures Jesus with visible tears and a compassionate expression on a stone path, perfectly reflecting the text's message of His tender empathy and love.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus pointing authoritatively toward the sealed stone tomb while Martha gestures with anxious hesitation.
The illustration perfectly depicts Jesus standing with his hand near his chest looking down at Martha with serene conviction, with the stone tomb clearly visible in the background.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus praying toward heaven in front of the open tomb while men roll away the heavy stone.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus calling forth Lazarus in grave clothes before an astonished crowd.
The illustration beautifully captures the joyful miracle with Lazarus emerging unbound from the tomb, Jesus smiling warmly in the center, and the women weeping with joy.
